Date:

Two children were injured in the bombing of the Syrian regime in southern Idlib on Oct 20

Related News

Man killed, two others injured, in a ground regime attack in W. Aleppo, October 3, 2024

Body of man named Osama al-Jawabra found in E. Daraa, October 1, 2024

Man named Abdul Aziz al-Dahik dies due to torture in regime detention centers, September 30, 2024

Syrian regime forces used a guided missile to bomb a car belonging to a family who were picking olives in an agricultural area adjacent to Majdaliya village in the southern suburbs of Idlib governorate, on October 20, 2022, injuring two children from the family, as well as inflicting extensive damage on the car.

The two injured children have been identified as 12-year-old Awad Muhammad al-Qassum and seven-year-old Muhanna Khaled Qassum, both of whom are from Kafr Batikh village, east of Idlib governorate.

The Syrian Network for Human Rights condemns Syrian regime forces’ bombardment of civilian areas, and their failure to distinguish between civilian areas and military targets.
